# Adaptive Dark Mode Skill

> An Agent Skill (SKILL.md format) that audits a website's theming and makes it ready for Safari 27.3's Adaptive Dark Mode, which automatically darkens light sites that don't declare `color-scheme: light dark`. It includes a static audit (Python), a runtime light/dark probe (browser JavaScript), copy-ready fixes, and framework notes. MIT licensed.

The skill lives in `skills/adaptive-dark-mode/`. Install by copying that folder into your agent's skills directory, or with `/plugin marketplace add BoughtSpot/adaptive-dark-mode-skill` in Claude Code.

## Skill
- [SKILL.md](https://github.com/BoughtSpot/adaptive-dark-mode-skill/blob/main/skills/adaptive-dark-mode/SKILL.md): workflow, the three-path decision, fix order, report template
- [Safari facts and open questions](https://github.com/BoughtSpot/adaptive-dark-mode-skill/blob/main/skills/adaptive-dark-mode/references/adm-facts.md)
- [Fix patterns](https://github.com/BoughtSpot/adaptive-dark-mode-skill/blob/main/skills/adaptive-dark-mode/references/fix-patterns.md): color-scheme, light-dark(), theme toggles, images, canvas
- [Framework notes](https://github.com/BoughtSpot/adaptive-dark-mode-skill/blob/main/skills/adaptive-dark-mode/references/frameworks.md): Tailwind, Next.js, SvelteKit, Rails, Bootstrap, MUI, WordPress
- [Verification](https://github.com/BoughtSpot/adaptive-dark-mode-skill/blob/main/skills/adaptive-dark-mode/references/verification.md)

## Tools
- [audit.py](https://github.com/BoughtSpot/adaptive-dark-mode-skill/blob/main/skills/adaptive-dark-mode/scripts/audit.py): static scanner, Python 3.9+ stdlib
- [probe.js](https://github.com/BoughtSpot/adaptive-dark-mode-skill/blob/main/skills/adaptive-dark-mode/scripts/probe.js): runtime probe, one browser expression
